comparisons.name: banner-light
comparisons.description: The notification of the Notifications view, Aqua, over the panel colours measured above it. Masked: the text, set in the fallback font off Apple platforms (app name, time, title, message) and the app icon, which is Apple artwork.

comparisons.description: The notification of the Notifications view, Dark Aqua, over the panel colours measured above it. Masked: the text, set in the fallback font off Apple platforms (app name, time, title, message) and the app icon, which is Apple artwork.

comparisons.name: clear-on-hover-light
comparisons.description: With the pointer over the card the clear button takes the icon's place, Aqua. No capture shows it; the disc's colour is the one measured on the clear button of the day heading.

pixels.note: disc of the clear button, above its cross: measured on the day heading's button (spec: notification-center, Clear button); on a card it is inferred
